settings.title: Tico settings
settings.followCursor: Appear on the monitor where the mouse is
settings.followCursorHint: If off, it always appears on the main monitor.
settings.hideOnFullscreen: Don't appear over full-screen apps (games, video)
settings.apiKeyHint: The key is stored in your system keychain, never in a file. You only pay for what you use on your provider account.
settings.ollamaHint: Install Ollama and download a vision model, for example: ollama pull gemma3
settings.captureMode.screen: The screen where the mouse is
settings.captureConfirm: Show me the thumbnail before sending
settings.blockedAppsHint: One per line. If any is on screen (in the app name or the window title), Tico won't capture anything.
settings.shortcutHint: Click and press the new combination (with Ctrl/⌘, Alt or Shift). Esc cancels.
settings.privacy: No telemetry, no accounts. Everything stays on your computer; screenshots are never written to disk.
island.role.tico: Your all-round assistant: ask me anything.
island.role.code: I help you write and fix code.
island.role.write: I polish your texts and emails.
island.role.teach: I explain anything step by step.
island.dropHint: I'll read them, summarise them or turn them into PDF
island.filesActions: What should I do with these {count} files?
island.prompt.summary: Summarise the important points of this file.
island.noRecent: The PDFs I make for you will show up here.
island.lookingForDoc: Looking for the document you have open…
island.pickDocument: I can't see any open Word document: choose the file you want as a PDF.
island.notice.noVision: This model can't see images: I used the text read from the screen.
island.notice.modelChanged: The chosen model no longer exists: I switched to {detail}.
island.notice.retrying: The service is busy; trying again ({detail})…
error.noCredit: Your {detail} account has no credit. Add some on their website or use a free AI (Gemini, Groq or Ollama).
error.overloaded: {detail} is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
error.timeout: {detail} took too long to answer. Try again.
error.noVision: This model can't see images. Pick one with vision or turn on OCR in Settings.
error.tooLarge: It's too big for {detail}. Try something shorter.
error.missingUrl: The custom service address is missing (Settings → Artificial intelligence).
error.noDocument: I can't find any open document.
settings.ticosHint: Make a Tico for each task: each one has its own look, its own way of answering and, if you like, its own AI. Each keeps its own conversation.
settings.instructionsHint: Instructions for the AI: its role, tone, language…
settings.ticoModelHint: Empty: the general model for that AI.
settings.seasonal: Seasonal outfits (Christmas, Halloween) when it isn't wearing anything
settings.keyLooksLike: This key looks like a {provider} key.
settings.lmstudioHint: Open LM Studio, download a model and start the local server (Developer → Start server).
settings.customHint: Any OpenAI-compatible service, for example https://my-server/v1. The key is optional.
settings.demoHint: Sample answers to try Tico without a key or internet.
settings.freeTip: No key? Gemini, Groq and OpenRouter have free options, and Ollama or LM Studio run on your computer for free.
settings.autoCapture: Look at the screen by itself when I ask (“what's on my screen?”)
settings.ocr: Read the text on the screen (system OCR)
settings.ocrHint: This way it reads even small print and also works with models that can't see images. It all happens on your computer.
settings.pdfHint: To make PDFs I use Word, Excel or PowerPoint (Windows), Pages, Numbers or Keynote (Mac) or LibreOffice if you have them; otherwise I do it myself. Just ask: “turn this Word into a PDF”.
pet.hello: Hi! I'm {name}. Click me to talk
settings.desktopTicoHint: A Tico that floats over your windows: drag it anywhere and click it to open the island. Right-click for its menu.
island.folder.missing: I can't find this workspace's folder. Pick another one in Settings.
settings.workspacesHint: Group your Ticos by workspace (school, work, coding…). Each workspace has its own Ticos, context and folder, and each Tico keeps a separate conversation in each workspace.
settings.workspaceTicosHint: Tap a Tico to add or remove it. A Tico can be in several workspaces.
settings.workspaceInstructionsHint: Every Tico in this workspace knows it.
settings.workspaceInstructionsPlaceholde: E.g. I'm in my final year of high school; use examples from the syllabus.
settings.workspaceFolderHint: Its files show up in the Files tab and Tico knows what's there.
settings.workspaceAppsHint: One per line: the app name or a word from the window title. If you open the island while using one of them, Tico switches to this workspace.
settings.autoWorkspaceHint: When the island opens it checks which app you're using. If you then pick another workspace by hand, it keeps it until you switch apps.
settings.dataHint: Tico keeps your settings, conversations and converted PDFs in a database on your computer (tico.db). It never leaves it. API keys live in the system keychain and screenshots are never saved.
settings.saveHistoryHint: When you reopen Tico, each Tico remembers what you talked about. Turn it off and they forget when it closes.
settings.pdfsCleared: PDF history cleared (the files are still there).
error.database: I couldn't save to the database: {detail}.
welcome.hello.title: Hi, I'm Tico
welcome.hello.lead: I live at the top of your screen and help you without switching windows.
welcome.hello.f1: I look at your screen when you ask and explain what's there.
welcome.hello.f2: I read your files and turn your Word documents into PDFs myself.
welcome.hello.f3: You get a Tico for every task and every workspace.
welcome.ai.title: Choose the AI I'll use
welcome.ai.lead: Not sure? Gemini is free and great at reading your screen.
welcome.ai.more: There are more (OpenRouter, Mistral, DeepSeek, Grok, LM Studio…) in Settings, and you can switch AI any time from the chat.
welcome.ai.gemini: By Google. Free with your account and great with images.
welcome.ai.groq: Free and very fast. Great for text and translations.
welcome.ai.anthropic: Claude: the most careful at writing and reasoning. Pay as you go.
welcome.ai.openai: The ChatGPT models. Pay as you go.
welcome.ai.ollama: Runs on your computer, offline and free.
welcome.ai.demo: Sample answers to try me without a key.
welcome.connect.title: Connect {provider}
welcome.connect.step2: Create an API key and copy it.
welcome.connect.step3: Paste it here and press Connect.
welcome.connect.safeWin: Your key is stored in Windows Credential Manager, never in a file.
welcome.connect.safeMac: Your key is stored in the macOS Keychain, never in a file.
welcome.connect.ollama2: Download a model in the terminal:
welcome.connect.ollama3: Keep Ollama open and press Check.
welcome.connect.demoLead: I'll reply with sample answers so you can see how I work. When you want a real AI, pick one in Settings or from the chat.
welcome.how.title: How to call me
welcome.how.edge: Move the mouse to the top edge of the screen and I'll drop down.
welcome.how.shortcut: Or use this shortcut from any app to start typing right away.
welcome.how.tip1: Ask "what's on my screen?" and I'll look.
welcome.how.tip2: Drop a file on the island or say "turn this Word into a PDF".
welcome.how.tip3: Type / in the chat to see every command.
welcome.done.title: All set!
welcome.done.lead: Two more things, if you like. You can change them in Settings any time.
suggest.tico.3: Turn my Word into a PDF
suggest.code.1: Review the code on my screen
settings.checkUpdatesHint: Asks GitHub for the latest version. Nothing about you is sent.
island.mailOpened: ✉️ Draft opened in your mail app
island.mailOpenedNoAttach: ✉️ Drag the file into the email: I've shown it for you
mail.title: New email
mail.subject: Subject
mail.notReady: To send it from Tico, connect your email (1 minute).
mail.from: Sent with your account ({host}). Ctrl+Enter to send.
mail.tooBig: Attachments weigh {size}: the limit is 24 MB.
error.mailSetup: Set up your email in Settings → Email.
error.mailAuth: Your email rejected the password. Use an app password, not your normal one.
error.noMailApp: I can't find a mail app on this computer.
settings.mailHint: Connect your account and Tico will send the files you drop on it by itself. The password goes in the system keychain. Without it, the email opens in your app (Outlook, Thunderbird or Mail) with the file attached.
settings.mailNameHint: Recipients see it and it signs your emails.
settings.mailPasswordHint: Gmail, iCloud, Yahoo and Outlook require a special app password (with 2-step verification on). Don't use your normal one.
settings.mailUnknownServer: I don't know your email server: enter it under Advanced options.
media.emptyHint: Play something on Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube and control it here: pause, next, previous and volume.
